title: PNP-CIDG subpoenas over 20 individuals in Laos shabu shipment probe
summary: The Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (PNP-CIDG) has subpoenaed more than 20 individuals as part of its investigation into a shipment of shabu intercepted in Laos…

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (PNP-CIDG) has subpoenaed more than 20 individuals as part of its investigation into a shipment of shabu intercepted in Laos that was allegedly bound for the Philippines.
